name: 100-Go de Start! Ei Kaiwa
summary: 100-Go de Start! Ei Kawa was a cancelled educational game for the Wii which was jointly developed by the Japanese broadcasting company NHK and Nintendo planned for release in 2009. Announced at a Nintendo press conference held on October 2, 2008 alongside NHK Kohaku Quiz Kassen, it was a video game adaptation of the Japanese educational TV program of the same name which taught viewers how to learn the English language via different skits.
